results.corrected_extracted: Carriers of the intake-lowering ADH1B variant reported 17.2% fewer UK units a week (one unit 7.9 g of ethanol) than non-carriers. By self-reported drinking, carriers against non-carriers: odds of hypertension 0.95 (0.89 to 1.02) in people reporting no drinking (53,211), 0.98 (0.93 to 1.03) at more than 0 to under 21 units a week (123,870) and 0.89 (0.81 to 0.99) at 21 or more (39,000), test for trend P = 0.197; for systolic blood pressure the trend P was 0.07. The overall hypertension association (0.94) was clear only in the heaviest-drinking stratum.
